summary: std/http: an HTTP/2 server decodes a header field cut across CONTINUATION frames once (GO-2023-1571), and an empty CONTINUATION frame that does not end the block is not decoded at all
details: an HTTP/2 server decodes a header field cut across CONTINUATION frames once (GO-2023-1571), and an empty CONTINUATION frame that does not end the block is not decoded at all. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
changelog: - Security (std/http, native backends): an HTTP/2 server decodes a header field cut across CONTINUATION frames once (GO-2023-1571), and an empty CONTINUATION frame that does not end the block is not decoded at all. Affected: 0.50.1 and earlier.
